item.title: Charlotte by Victoria-Maria Interior Design
item.description: Charlotte sets a richly atmospheric tone inside a historic maison de maître near a central Brussels lake, transformed by Victoria-Maria Interior Design into a generous family apartment. Across approximately 600 square meters, the project leans into a warm, global-inflected interior style, where rust and golden hues fold into layered textiles, collected objects, and crafted details. Every room feels composed for daily life yet tuned to the character of the building. Read more ...Related:Francesca

item.title: Two-Generation House in Coulée Douce by La Nony FAMILI
item.description: Two-Generation House in Coulée Douce stands in the forests of Sutton, Canada, where La Nony FAMILI shapes a multi-generational house around pond views and quiet comfort. The elongated volume settles into the sloping site, giving each generation privacy while keeping daily life centered on shared rooms and a material palette tuned to light, texture, and calm. item.title: ST House by Roberto Lebrero
item.description: ST House stands on a sloping hillside in Spain, where Roberto Lebrero works with the terrain to frame long views and precise interior rhythms. Conceived as a house for three siblings, the project breaks the domestic brief into distinct volumes that drift across the slope, tying private life, shared rooms, and the surrounding valley into one measured composition. item.title: Apartment in Kifissia Reframes Modernist Roots with Lush Color
item.description: Apartment in Kifissia reworks a 1980s apartment in Kifisia, Greece, with a clear eye on its modernist bones and open plan. Panagiotis Papanikolaou Design Studio preserves the generous windows and original wood while threading in new color and material cues that echo the surrounding landscape. The result is an updated urban home that respects its past yet feels distinctly present. item.title: Francesca’s House: Lively Family Apartment Crafted for Digital Life
item.description: Francesca's House sets a vivid scene in Desio, Italy, where Storie Design Studio reworks a traditional apartment around a young family’s daily rituals and digital presence. Exposed beams, bold color and custom solutions respond to influencer Francesca Biella’s need for a home that reads as both lived-in retreat and ready-made set. Each room supports family life first, then quietly steps forward for the camera when the story begins again. Read more ...Related:Bronze and Black House by SPF:archite

item.title: Studio & Guest House In New York Reimagines Cabin-Style Comfort Living
item.description: Studio & Guest House sits in the woods near Accord in New York, United States, where Neil Logan, Architect reworks two modest structures into a paired retreat. The project turns an existing house and storage building into a dedicated studio and guest house, holding onto their footprints while stripping back interiors to calm, timber-lined rooms. Light, material, and measured openings guide the experience from arrival to deep in the trees. Read more ...Related:Bangalow Road House: Timber Screens

item.title: Bronze and Black House by SPF:architects
item.description: Bronze and Black House steps lightly across a Los Angeles hillside, its long upper volume skimming above gardens and pool. SPF:architects arranges the house and companion studio along a decisive linear spine, tying together cul-de-sac ends and calibrating every room to the surrounding views. Inside the house, warm materials and generous glazing support open daily living while keeping the experience of the steep site legible from morning to night. item.title: Block House: Interior by Studio MA
item.description: Block House: Interior sits within a three-level house in Prague, Czechia, where Studio MA works directly with the sloping terrain of Šárecké Valley. The project refines everyday living with clear geometry, long views and a restrained material palette that connects the main living floor, the private spa level and the roof-terrace bedrooms into one continuous experience. Calm light, durable finishes and precise proportion drive the atmosphere throughout the home. Read more ...Related:Bangalow Road

item.title: Apartment in Kichijoji by Roovice
item.description: Apartment in Kichijoji renovates a compact apartment in Musashino, Japan, reworking daily life around a larger, more open kitchen by Roovice. The project turns a former 3LDK layout into a generous living–dining–kitchen zone, where exposed structure, oak parquet, and custom carpentry support a brighter, more connected way of living. Every move favors shared rooms and easy circulation while respecting the calm character of a residential neighborhood. Read more ...Related:In a Park by L ARCHITECTSG

item.title: Bangalow Road House: Timber Screens Shape a Calm Urban Retreat
item.description: Bangalow Road House stands on a narrow 360m² corner block in Byron Bay, Australia, shaped by Son Studio as a compact, efficient family house. The project responds to tight height and boundary controls with stacked timber volumes and a central courtyard that mediate between a busy street and calm interior life. Within this modest footprint, the house treats light, screening, and climate as core architectural tools rather than add-ons. Read more ...Related:Block House: Interior by Studio MAStudio
